mechanism: Targeted raw-signal perturbation suppresses allele-level evidence at the pathogenic F11 locus.
observed_result: On-target ALT support fell to 0/14 evaluable parent reads under targeted PM2.
limitations: Single HG002 individual, one F11 pathogenic locus and one controlled basecalling configuration.

mechanism: Loss of variant-calling evidence propagates into loss of the clinically relevant F11 variant representation.
observed_result: The controlled targeted condition produced downstream loss of the F11 variant call.
limitations: Computational consequence only; no patient outcome or clinical decision was observed.

mechanism: Clean replay establishes that the pathogenic allele is normally retained through basecalling into variant evidence.
observed_result: Clean ALT support was retained in 14/14 evaluable parents.
limitations: Baseline control; not an independent risk contribution.

mechanism: Matched off-target perturbation tests whether the F11 effect is localized rather than a nonspecific pipeline failure.
observed_result: Off-target PM2 sham preserved ALT evidence in 14/14 evaluable parents and preserved the heterozygous call.
limitations: Single matched sham control at the tested locus.

mechanism: Disclosure of pathogenic genomic information reduces the modelled ability to restore privacy after release.
limitations: Model-derived vault result; interpretation depends on the configured disclosure and reconstruction assumptions.

mechanism: Persistent genomic disclosure accumulates downstream re-identification and familial exposure over time.
observed_result: Modelled re-identification reached 100 percent by year 13 and familial exposure reached 100 percent by year 15.
limitations: Temporal saturation is modelled rather than measured in a longitudinal population cohort.

mechanism: Release of one person's genomic information propagates through kinship relationships and amplifies exposure.
observed_result: The authoritative graph contained 4144 nodes with 1657 registered nodes; calibrated mean familial amplification was 464.4x.
limitations: Graph-derived and calibration-dependent; not a direct population-wide empirical exposure count.

mechanism: Graph-aware containment limits already-propagated exposure, with effectiveness dependent on attack origin.
observed_result: Primary containment achieved 99.24 percent best reduction; minimum tested k for >=99 percent reduction was 5 for peripheral origins and 20 for mid-degree and hub origins.
limitations: Mitigation evidence only. It must not reduce Base GRI unless an explicitly defined modifier analysis is applied.

mechanism: Authentication provides an access-control mitigation layer for genomic-platform misuse.
observed_result: Final benchmark threshold 3.6 produced precision 0.9070, recall 0.7800, F1 0.8387 and accuracy 0.9400.
limitations: Authentication performance is not a direct measure of privacy-event detectability and is not a Base GRI input.
